newsitem.title: UK: HarCros little moved by in-line results.
newsitem.headline: HarCros little moved by in-line results.

text.p: Shares in Harrisons and Crosfield were unchanged at 135-1/2p in early trading after headline first-half profits came in as expected, analysts said.
Pre-tax profits in the six months of 1996 slipped to 64 million stg from 66.4 million stg the previous year. The dividend was unchanged at 3.6 pence per share.

But there was some concern with the underlying figures, said one analyst. "The headline figures were in-line, the surprise is the make-up. The Plantations side has done very well and above our expectations but against that the timber results are very disappointing," said Tony Shepard of Greig Middleton.
"The big question going forward is that with Plantations making such a large contribution, can the existing divisions take up the shortfall when Plantations drops out?" he said.
The completion of the sale of Harrisons' Plantation interests is due to take place in October.
